data.long_meaning: Ejaj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ijaj' which means 'Victory' or 'Triumph'. In Hindu mythology, Ejaj is a name associated with gods and victories. It is believed to bring success and good fortune. The name Ejaj carries the meaning “Victory, Triumph” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ejaj usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, triumph and live with faith, good character and purpose.
